title: The Theatre of Terror
description: While trying to save a landmark movie theater, Amber meets the eccentric Colin who insists on taking her for a tour of the once-grand auditorium. Amber can't resist staying to watch a few short films, but doesn't realize the tales of terror are more than just fantasy.

title: Elijah and the Rock Creature
description: A lost boy on a family camping trip meets a fantastical creature that helps him get home.

title: Lost cos
description: Haunted by her tortured childhood, Eni, a dental assistant, escapes to Los Cos, a mysterious underground club where cosplay and burlesque intertwine; when a cosplayer is found dead on a New Jersey beach, Eni must confront her fears.

title: Underdogs
description: A new coach (D.B. Sweeney) inspires teenage football players to reach their full potential while the team's quarterback falls for a cheerleader from their main rivals.

title: An Innocent Kiss
description: While Billy and Ellie struggle to save their marriage, Billy's wayward brother arrives and spreads havoc in the family.

title: Still Breathing
description: A Texas street performer (Brendan Fraser) has visions of his future wife (Joanna Going), a Los Angeles con artist.

title: Zapas
description: Young men climb a waterfall to jump into a lake to become adults.

title: Girl on a Bicycle
description: In Paris, an Italian bus driver (Vincenzo Amato) becomes infatuated with an alluring cyclist and seeks advice from his womanizing best friend (Paddy Considine) about how to meet her.

title: Modern Day Slavery
description: The racial disparity and corporate exploitation of African-American and Latino prisoners within the United States Justice System.

title: I Had a Bloody Good Time at House Harker
description: In order to save their family home, two awkward brothers and their idiot friend hire a vampire-actor to scare the townspeople, but things get crazy when the vampire turns out to be the real thing.

title: 20 Million Miles to Earth
description: A manned space flight from Venus crash lands in the Mediterranean, losing its most precious cargo: reptilian eggs from the planet's surface. They come into the possession of an Italian zoologist (Frank Puglia), who watches as one hatches to reveal a rapidly-growing monster. His American granddaughter, Marisa (Joan Taylor), and returned astronaut Calder (William Hopper) must battle with the American and Italian military to corral the creature before it destroys everything in its path.

title: Menopause
description: A solar eclipse interferes with the menstrual cycle of women around the world, causing them to feel murderous rage and kill every man they see. Some women try to fight it, while others embrace their newfound bloodlust.

title: Come Home
description: Two couples, seeking refuge in the Adirondack mountains, find themselves marked by trapped souls that inhabit the forest. Losing their grip on reality, and each other, they must find a way out of an often foretold tale.
